content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates shall enclose self-attested copies of the following documents: SSC/10th Class Certificate for proof of age. All relevant educational qualification certificates. Marks memos of all years/semesters of the qualifying course. Community/Caste Certificate, wherever applicable. EWS Certificate, wherever applicable. PwD Certificate, wherever applicable. Local candidature/Study Certificates, wherever applicable. Aadhaar Card/other prescribed identity proof. Experience Certificate, wherever applicable. Proof of payment of application fee, if prescribed. Any other document prescribed by the Government/DSC. Candidates shall produce the original certificates at the time of certificate verification/counselling.

content_sections.text: Note: Demand Draft to be paid in Favor of District Medical & Health Officer, Suryapet.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection shall be made by the District Selection Committee, Suryapet, on behalf of the District Health Society. Selection shall be made strictly on merit. Merit shall be calculated on the basis of the combined percentage of marks obtained in Qualifying Examination (90 marks) and Age (10 marks). as applicable, for a total of 100 marks. The Rule of Reservation shall be followed as per the Government orders in force. The Presidential Order, 2018, shall be followed as applicable. As per the applicable Presidential Order, Senior Dots Plus TBHIV Supervisor are District level posts. The prescribed roster shall be followed. Candidates shall be considered for posting based on merit-cum-option, subject to eligibility, roster and availability of vacancies. In case of a tie in merit, the tie-breaking criteria prescribed by the Government/NHM shall be followed. The provisional merit list shall be displayed and objections shall be invited within the prescribed period. After disposal of objections, the final merit list and selection list shall be prepared and displayed by the District Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Dots Plus TBHIV Supervisor post?
faq.answer: A total of (01) vacancy is available.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: Applications shall be submitted from 23.10.2026 to 29.10.2026 on office timings at 10.30 AM to 5.00PM on all working days.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Bachelor Degree or recognized Sanitary Inspector’s course, Certificate course of computer operation (Min.2 months), Permanent 2-Wheeler Driving License.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years in terms of (Rule-12(1)(a)(v) of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules 1996), reckoned as on 01.07.2026, with relaxations allowed as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 500/- for General Candidates and Rs. 250/- for EWS/BC/SC/ST/Minority/Ex-Ser./PHC candidates, etc., to be paid via Demand Draft in Favor of District Medical & Health Officer, Suryapet.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered?
Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection shall be made strictly on merit calculated on the basis of the combined percentage of marks obtained in Qualifying Examination (90 marks) and Age (10 marks), as applicable, for a total of 100 marks.

faq.question: Q8. Is this appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on contract basis and does not confer any right for regular appointment under the Government.
